inputs.name: BRANCHES
inputs.description: Branch codes, OCCURS 1 TO 8 of PIC X(4)

wire.text: the items joined by `,` with nothing around it, such as `a,b`
wire.platform: a list of strings, such as `[a, b]`; docuconf writes it in the wire format

constraints.text: each item between 2 and 4 characters (Unicode code points)

sources.text: a literal value in the platform's values file
supplied when the container starts by an injector (`injected`), such as Bank-Vaults, `op run` or the Vault Agent injector; checked at boot

inputs.name: CALLBACK_URL
inputs.description: Where to report the run, PIC X(40)

sources.text: a literal value in the platform's values file
a key of a ConfigMap (`configMapKeyRef`), checked at boot
supplied when the container starts by an injector (`injected`), such as Bank-Vaults, `op run` or the Vault Agent injector; checked at boot

inputs.name: LIMITS
inputs.description: Run limits as JSON, PIC X(35)

wire.platform: a JSON value (written as YAML or JSON in the values file)

sources.text: a literal value in the platform's values file
a key of a ConfigMap (`configMapKeyRef`), checked at boot
supplied when the container starts by an injector (`injected`), such as Bank-Vaults, `op run` or the Vault Agent injector; checked at boot

errors.meaning: The value does not parse as the input's type in its wire format, or a secret still holds an unresolved injector reference (`vault:`, `op://`, `ref+`).
errors.fix: Write the value in the input's wire format. For an injected secret, make sure the injector runs.

errors.meaning: A number, duration, length, list item or key is outside the input's bounds; an empty key always is.
errors.fix: Use a value within the input's constraints.

errors.meaning: The URL's scheme is not one of the allowed schemes.
errors.fix: Use a URL with an allowed scheme.

errors.meaning: The list has fewer items than its minimum, or the key set fewer keys.
The list has more items than its maximum, or the key set more keys.
errors.fix: Remove items, or keys: a key set holds the old key only until the rotation is done.
